vct_goals.name: Demand Forecast Accuracy
vct_goals.description: Accuracy of item-level demand forecasts used to drive supply, inventory, and budget decisions

vct_goals.name: Budget-to-Actual Accuracy
vct_goals.description: Closeness of planned versus actual revenue and spend across all functions and time horizons

vct_goals.name: Market Opportunity Capture
vct_goals.description: Percentage of addressable market opportunity converted to active pipeline or revenue in the period

vct_goals.name: Innovation Pipeline Velocity
vct_goals.description: Speed and throughput at which ideas are converted into funded, in-flight innovation projects

vct_goals.name: Competitive Positioning Accuracy
vct_goals.description: Precision of competitive intelligence and price/assortment positioning relative to the competitive set

vct_goals.name: Customer Segmentation Precision
vct_goals.description: Accuracy and actionability of customer segment definitions driving targeting, pricing, and assortment

vct_goals.name: New Product Revenue Share
vct_goals.description: Percentage of total revenue attributable to products launched in the past 12 months

vct_goals.name: Product Cost Efficiency
vct_goals.description: COGS efficiency of the product portfolio — actual cost per SKU vs. design targets, including landed cost

vct_goals.name: Portfolio Lifecycle Health
vct_goals.description: Balance and velocity of active, scaling, and retiring SKUs across the full catalog

vct_goals.name: Tech Platform Reliability
vct_goals.description: Uptime, deployment cadence, and stability of product technology and tooling platforms

vct_goals.name: Product Quality & Compliance
vct_goals.description: Pre- and post-launch defect rates, warranty claims, and regulatory compliance pass rates

vct_goals.name: Commercialization Execution
vct_goals.description: Readiness and accuracy of listing, inventory, channel setup, and initial content at product launch

vct_goals.name: Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
vct_goals.description: Revenue attributable to paid advertising divided by total advertising cost across all paid channels

vct_goals.name: Organic Search Performance
vct_goals.description: Share and rank quality of organic search traffic driven by listing content and SEO optimization

vct_goals.name: Content Quality Coverage
vct_goals.description: Percentage of the active catalog with complete, channel-approved, high-quality digital content

vct_goals.name: Campaign Execution Speed
vct_goals.description: Reliability and timeliness of launching campaigns and content against planned schedule

vct_goals.name: Content Cost Efficiency
vct_goals.description: Cost per produced and published content asset relative to asset lifecycle revenue contribution

vct_goals.name: Digital Asset Lifecycle Health
vct_goals.description: Currency, utilization, and governance quality of the digital asset library

vct_goals.name: Supplier Cost Efficiency
vct_goals.description: Unit cost performance relative to targets across all cost components: purchase price, freight, duties, and rebates

vct_goals.name: Manufacturing Yield
vct_goals.description: Percentage of manufactured units passing first-pass quality inspection without rework or rejection

vct_goals.name: Supplier Reliability
vct_goals.description: Supplier ability to fulfill purchase orders on time, in full, and to specification

vct_goals.name: Demand-Driven Procurement
vct_goals.description: Alignment of purchase orders with forward demand forecasts, minimizing overstock and emergency buys

vct_goals.name: Inventory Investment Efficiency
vct_goals.description: Efficiency of capital deployed in inventory: turnover, weeks of supply, and excess & obsolete reserve rate

vct_goals.name: Supply Chain Resilience
vct_goals.description: Diversification and auditability of the supplier base against single-source and geo-political risk

vct_goals.name: Search Demand
vct_goals.description: Total addressable search demand available to the catalog, representing external market pull

vct_goals.name: Impression Share
vct_goals.description: Percentage of available impressions captured through organic rank and sponsored placements

vct_goals.name: Click-Through Rate
vct_goals.description: Percentage of impressions that result in a customer clicking through to the product detail page

vct_goals.name: Conversion Rate
vct_goals.description: Percentage of product detail page visits that result in a completed purchase

vct_goals.name: BuyBox Win Rate
vct_goals.description: Percentage of time the product listing holds the BuyBox, enabling direct purchase

vct_goals.name: Average Order Value
vct_goals.description: Average dollar value per completed order, influenced by bundling, pricing, and mix

vct_goals.name: Inventory Availability
vct_goals.description: Ability to fulfill orders immediately from on-hand stock without delay or substitution

vct_goals.name: Pick & Pack Accuracy
vct_goals.description: Accuracy of order picking and packing, minimizing costly errors, reshipments, and customer contacts

vct_goals.name: Shipment On-Time Rate
vct_goals.description: Percentage of orders shipped by the promised carrier pickup or ship-confirm deadline

vct_goals.name: Labor Productivity
vct_goals.description: Output efficiency of warehouse labor measured in units processed per hour and cost per unit shipped

vct_goals.name: Carrier & Freight Cost Management
vct_goals.description: Efficiency of outbound carrier selection, zone optimization, and freight cost per shipped unit

vct_goals.name: Returns Processing Efficiency
vct_goals.description: Speed and cost efficiency of receiving, inspecting, and dispositioning returned inventory

vct_goals.name: Last-Mile Delivery Performance
vct_goals.description: Reliability of final delivery to the customer preventing chargebacks, refunds, and NPS damage

vct_goals.name: Customer Satisfaction
vct_goals.description: Post-purchase satisfaction driving repeat purchase, LTV, review quality, and word-of-mouth revenue

vct_goals.name: Review & Reputation Management
vct_goals.description: Quality and velocity of channel reviews and seller scores that protect margin and conversion rate

vct_goals.name: Revenue Recognition Accuracy
vct_goals.description: Timeliness and accuracy of recording revenue, affecting financial reporting and working capital

vct_goals.name: Cash Conversion Efficiency
vct_goals.description: Speed and completeness of converting recognized revenue into collected cash within payment terms

vct_goals.name: Customer Retention & Loyalty
vct_goals.description: Long-term retention of high-value customers driving compounding revenue from repeat and loyalty spend
